analogue: Two isoprene-derived hydroxyperoxy radicals HO–C₅H₈O₂ form gaseous C₁₀H₁₈O₄ accretion product plus O₂.
citation: First oxidation products from the reaction of hydroxyl radicals with isoprene for pristine environmental conditions
evidence: Direct sampling of products from OH + isoprene identified the C₁₀ accretion product assigned to the first-generation hydroxyperoxy radical self-reaction.
difference: The Manchester lump aggregates many oxidation products and immediately assigns the accretion flux to stable suspended material; the paper measured gaseous products and does not establish that condensed yield or rate.
